literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 这 40 条热门帖子收到了 5,107 条评论、144,940 条点赞和 7,358 条回复。评论在公告发布后两小时内达到顶峰,并在四小时后下降。公众最关心的是猴痘的态度和猴痘的模式。情绪分析显示,负面评论居多(76.13%),负面EV是正面评论的32.31倍。评论、点赞和回复的数量均与 EV 显着相关 (p < 0.001)。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0354150]
提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.1002/advs.76926]
总共包括 1,614 人:其中 960 人来自里约热内卢,654 人来自里斯本。疫情曲线显示出类似的上升和下降模式,里斯本的峰值较早(2022年6月),里约热内卢的峰值较晚(2022年8月)。皮肤或粘膜病变是这两种情况下最常报告的表现,影响超过 85% 的个体。里约热内卢更常报告发烧,而里斯本更常报告淋巴结病和乏力。 [10.1186/s12879-026-14087-8]
审查得出的结论是,猴痘病毒,特别是进化枝 Ib 和进化枝 IIb,具有不同的 传播 模式和疾病严重程度概况。进化枝 Ib 似乎传播得更广泛,影响非性人群,而进化枝 IIb 主要通过性传播。该病毒还采用免疫逃避策略,例如破坏干扰素信号传导和创建诱饵受体。 [10.1016/j.mimet.2026.107656]
该研究报告称,向皮内给药的过渡已成功实施,没有发现任何不良反应。没有具体说明通过这种方法接种疫苗的患者的确切人数。 [10.51256/anj082614]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The 40 popular posts received 5,107 comments, 144,940 likes, and 7,358 responses. Comments peaked within two hours after the announcement and declined after four hours. The public was most concerned about attitudes and transmission mode of mpox. [10.1371/journal.pone.0354150]
Median age was 30 years, and 73/155 (47%) had HIV infection. Multisite pain, particularly anogenital, was highly prevalent. [10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106409]
The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.1002/advs.76926]

A total of 1,614 individuals were included: 960 from Rio de Janeiro and 654 from Lisbon. The epidemic curves showed a similar rise-and-decline pattern, with an earlier peak in Lisbon (June 2022) and a later peak in Rio de Janeiro (August 2022). [10.1186/s12879-026-14087-8]

The review concludes that the Mpox virus, particularly Clade Ib and Clade IIb, has distinct transmission patterns and disease severity profiles. Clade Ib appears to spread more widely, affecting non-sexual populations, while Clade IIb is primarily transmitted sexually. [10.1016/j.mimet.2026.107656]

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世卫组织非洲区域办事处报告乌干达确诊一例 猴痘 暴发,过去 24 小时报告新增 37 例病例。累计确诊324例,死亡1例。 [news-f466817f7963c6c7]
UKHSA 报告确认,截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日,英国已有 119 例 猴痘 Ib 分支病例,其中大多数病例发生在伦敦。它还注意到欧洲和北美通过 GBMSM 网络发现的社区 传播 以及 2025 年 12 月在英国发现的重组 猴痘病毒。 [news-6052ae8e16c38041]
Bavarian Nordic 已获得欧盟批准,将其 猴痘/天花 疫苗 的使用范围扩大到 2 岁儿童。 [news-4706289f514a7fa4]
欧盟委员会授权 Bavarian Nordic 的 IMVANEX 猴痘 和天花 疫苗 用于 2 岁至 12 岁以下儿童,这标志着非复制 猴痘 疫苗 首次正式获准用于该年龄段。该决定基于在刚果民主共和国和乌干达进行的 2 期临床研究 (NCT06549530)。 [news-2d65f5fd64414853]
下一代 猴痘 疫苗 被强调,显示出持久保护和未来 暴发 准备的承诺。《今日感染控制》报道了这一事件,并根据提供的证据证实了这一事件。 [news-592c382cb20c6a0c]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: The WHO Regional Office for Africa reported a confirmed mpox outbreak in Uganda, with thirty seven new cases reported in the past 24 hours. Cumulatively, 324 confirmed cases and one death have been registered. [news-f466817f7963c6c7]

The UKHSA report confirmed 119 mpox clade Ib cases in the UK up to 31 July 2026, with most cases in London. It also noted community transmission through GBMSM networks in Europe and North America and a recombinant mpox virus identified in England in December 2025. [news-6052ae8e16c38041]
Bavarian Nordic has received EU approval to expand the use of its mpox/smallpox vaccine to children as young as 2 years old. [news-4706289f514a7fa4]

The European Commission authorized Bavarian Nordic's IMVANEX mpox and smallpox vaccine for children aged 2 to under 12 years, marking the first time a non-replicating mpox vaccine was formally cleared for this age group. This decision was based on a Phase 2 clinical study (NCT06549530) conducted in the DRC and Uganda. [news-2d65f5fd64414853]

A next-generation Mpox vaccine was highlighted as showing promise for durable protection and future outbreak preparedness. The event was reported by Infection Control Today, and it is confirmed based on the evidence provided. [news-592c382cb20c6a0c]

papers.title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

papers.title: Integrated molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics perspectives on the Mpox virus: Implications for surveillance and Global Health preparedness.
papers.abstract: Mpox has re-emerged as a significant global zoonotic threat, driven mainly by two large waves the 2022 worldwide Clade IIb outbreak and the 2024 Clade Ib epidemic in Central Africa. This review examines the challenges of interpreting this evolving virus from molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics perspectives, with a focus on global health workforce preparedness. Clade IIb largely moved through sexual transmission across countries, but Clade Ib has appeared in a wider population-women, children, and individuals infected through household spread without any sexual contact. Early case series suggest that Clade Ib may cause a more severe disease burden, but more research is needed to directly compare severity and fatality rates with Clade IIb due to the limited number of current studies. The review examines the virus's strategies for evading the host's immune defenses throughout its ~197 kbp genome, including how it disrupts interferon signaling and creates decoy receptors. This review summarizes the clinical findings of PALM007 and STOMP, noting that neither trial achieved its main efficacy endpoint making routine tecovirimat use less compelling-while leaving open whether it helps particular high-risk groups. A further point is that immunity from the MVA-BN vaccine wanes with time, leading to the growing adoption of booster vaccinations. In conclusion, the review calls for a One Health approach pairing genomic tracking with ecological intelligence and including wastewater surveillance to fill existing gaps in knowledge and enhance the global handling of new orthopoxvirus threats.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the Mpox virus, examining its molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics characteristics, particularly its transmission patterns, immune evasion strategies, and implications for global health preparedness. The central question is how these aspects influence surveillance and response to mpox outbreaks, especially in light of the 2022 Clade IIb and 2024 Clade Ib epidemics.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the Mpox virus, drawing on molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics data. It includes case series and clinical trials such as PALM007 and STOMP, and discusses the use of genomic tracking, ecological intelligence, and wastewater surveillance as part of its methodology.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the Mpox virus, particularly Clade Ib and Clade IIb, has distinct transmission patterns and disease severity profiles. Clade Ib appears to spread more widely, affecting non-sexual populations, while Clade IIb is primarily transmitted sexually. The virus also employs immune evasion strategies, such as disrupting interferon signaling and creating decoy receptors.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is limited direct comparison of severity and fatality rates between Clade Ib and Clade IIb due to the small number of studies. Additionally, the efficacy of tecovirimat in routine use remains uncertain, though it may be beneficial for specific high-risk groups. The review also highlights the need for more research on immune responses and the role of booster vaccinations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the importance of a One Health approach that integrates genomic tracking, ecological intelligence, and wastewater surveillance to improve global preparedness. It also suggests the need for further research on immune responses, vaccine efficacy, and the development of targeted interventions for high-risk populations.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides an integrated analysis of the Mpox virus, focusing on its molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics features. It highlights the distinct transmission patterns of Clade Ib and Clade IIb, with Clade Ib spreading more widely among non-sexual populations. The review also discusses the virus's immune evasion strategies and the limitations of current treatments like tecovirimat. It calls for a One Health approach combining genomic tracking, ecological intelligence, and wastewater surveillance to enhance global health preparedness and address knowledge gaps in mpox disease management.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the Mpox virus, examining its molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics characteristics, particularly its transmission patterns, immune evasion strategies, and implications for global health preparedness. The central question is how these aspects influence surveillance and response to mpox outbreaks, especially in light of the 2022 Clade IIb and 2024 Clade Ib epidemics.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the Mpox virus, drawing on molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics data. It includes case series and clinical trials such as PALM007 and STOMP, and discusses the use of genomic tracking, ecological intelligence, and wastewater surveillance as part of its methodology.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the Mpox virus, particularly Clade Ib and Clade IIb, has distinct transmission patterns and disease severity profiles. Clade Ib appears to spread more widely, affecting non-sexual populations, while Clade IIb is primarily transmitted sexually. The virus also employs immune evasion strategies, such as disrupting interferon signaling and creating decoy receptors.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is limited direct comparison of severity and fatality rates between Clade Ib and Clade IIb due to the small number of studies. Additionally, the efficacy of tecovirimat in routine use remains uncertain, though it may be beneficial for specific high-risk groups. The review also highlights the need for more research on immune responses and the role of booster vaccinations.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the importance of a One Health approach that integrates genomic tracking, ecological intelligence, and wastewater surveillance to improve global preparedness. It also suggests the need for further research on immune responses, vaccine efficacy, and the development of targeted interventions for high-risk populations.

papers.title_zh: 猴痘病毒 的综合分子、流行病学和生物信息学观点:对 监测 和全球健康准备的影响。
papers.source_body_en: Mpox has re-emerged as a significant global zoonotic threat, driven mainly by two large waves the 2022 worldwide Clade IIb outbreak and the 2024 Clade Ib epidemic in Central Africa. This review examines the challenges of interpreting this evolving virus from molecular, epidemiological, and bioinformatics perspectives, with a focus on global health workforce preparedness. Clade IIb largely moved through sexual transmission across countries, but Clade Ib has appeared in a wider population-women, children, and individuals infected through household spread without any sexual contact. Early case series suggest that Clade Ib may cause a more severe disease burden, but more research is needed to directly compare severity and fatality rates with Clade IIb due to the limited number of current studies. The review examines the virus's strategies for evading the host's immune defenses throughout its ~197 kbp genome, including how it disrupts interferon signaling and creates decoy receptors. This review summarizes the clinical findings of PALM007 and STOMP, noting that neither trial achieved its main efficacy endpoint making routine tecovirimat use less compelling-while leaving open whether it helps particular high-risk groups. A further point is that immunity from the MVA-BN vaccine wanes with time, leading to the growing adoption of booster vaccinations. In conclusion, the review calls for a One Health approach pairing genomic tracking with ecological intelligence and including wastewater surveillance to fill existing gaps in knowledge and enhance the global handling of new orthopoxvirus threats.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘 重新成为全球重大人畜共患威胁,主要由 2022 年全球分支 IIb 暴发 和 2024 年中部非洲分支 Ib 流行这两大浪潮推动。这篇综述从分子、流行病学和生物信息学的角度审视了解释这种不断演变的病毒所面临的挑战,重点关注全球卫生人力的准备情况。分支IIb主要通过性传播在各国传播,但分支Ib出现在更广泛的人群中——妇女、儿童和通过家庭传播而没有任何性接触而感染的个人。早期病例系列表明,Clade Ib 可能会造成更严重的疾病负担,但由于目前研究数量有限,需要更多的研究来直接比较 Clade IIb 的严重程度和死亡率。该综述研究了该病毒在其约 197 kbp 基因组 中逃避 宿主 免疫防御的策略,包括它如何破坏干扰素信号传导并创建诱饵受体。这篇综述总结了 PALM007 和 STOMP 的临床结果,指出这两项试验都没有达到其主要疗效终点,使得常规 特考韦瑞 的使用不那么引人注目,但它是否有助于特定的高危人群仍悬而未决。更进一步的一点是,对 MVA-BN 疫苗 的免疫力会随着时间的推移而减弱,导致增强剂 疫苗接种 的采用越来越多。总之,该审查呼吁采用一种将基因组跟踪与生态智能相结合的“同一个健康”方法,并将废水 监测 纳入其中,以填补现有的知识空白,并加强全球对新 正痘病毒 威胁的处理。

papers.title: Lesion viral burden, multidrug-resistant superinfection, and HIV-associated haematological vulnerability in hospitalised clade Ib mpox: a prospective cohort study in Uganda
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox has shifted to sustained human-to-human transmission across Africa, yet integrated triage incorporating viral burden, bacterial co-infection, antimicrobial resistance (AMR), HIV status, and routine biomarkers remain scarce. METHODS: At Uganda's national mpox referral hospital, we prospectively enrolled 155 adults at 14 ± 2 days post-symptom onset; mpox was confirmed by lesion-swab qPCR (F3L), with clade assignment by whole-genome sequencing in a prespecified subset (March-April 2025). Lesion viral DNA burden was estimated using qPCR cycle threshold (Ct) values. Purulent lesions underwent EUCAST-standardised culture and susceptibility testing. Routine laboratory assessments included complete blood counts, C-reactive protein, serum chemistries, HIV serostatus, and plasma HIV-1 RNA. FINDINGS: Median age was 30 years, and 73/155 (47%) had HIV infection. Multisite pain, particularly anogenital, was highly prevalent. Among 80 participants with purulent lesions selected for clinically suspected bacterial superinfection, all yielded bacterial growth; 35/80 (43.8%) were polymicrobial and predominantly multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacilli. Susceptibility to first-line β-lactams and fluoroquinolones was low, whereas meropenem retained activity (51/61, 84%). Lesion viral burden did not differ by HIV serostatus and showed weak correlation with HIV-1 viraemia; higher burden was associated with leucocytosis, neutrophilia with left shift, elevated CRP, and hypoalbuminaemia. Genomes clustered within Clade Ib, without segregation by HIV status or clinical severity. INTERPRETATION: Hospitalised adults with acute Clade Ib mpox in Uganda exhibited high lesion viral burden, frequent multidrug-resistant bacterial co-isolation, and an inflammatory haematological profile accentuated in participants living with HIV-1. These findings support consideration of integrating diagnostic microbiology, HIV viral load assessment, and antimicrobial stewardship into mpox case-management in endemic settings. FUNDING: This study was supported by the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI; Project ID PRJ-8284).

papers.title_zh: 住院分支 Ib 猴痘 中的病变病毒负荷、多重耐药性重复感染和 HIV 相关血液学脆弱性:乌干达的一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Mpox has shifted to sustained human-to-human transmission across Africa, yet integrated triage incorporating viral burden, bacterial co-infection, antimicrobial resistance (AMR), HIV status, and routine biomarkers remain scarce. METHODS: At Uganda's national mpox referral hospital, we prospectively enrolled 155 adults at 14 ± 2 days post-symptom onset; mpox was confirmed by lesion-swab qPCR (F3L), with clade assignment by whole-genome sequencing in a prespecified subset (March-April 2025). Lesion viral DNA burden was estimated using qPCR cycle threshold (Ct) values. Purulent lesions underwent EUCAST-standardised culture and susceptibility testing. Routine laboratory assessments included complete blood counts, C-reactive protein, serum chemistries, HIV serostatus, and plasma HIV-1 RNA. FINDINGS: Median age was 30 years, and 73/155 (47%) had HIV infection. Multisite pain, particularly anogenital, was highly prevalent. Among 80 participants with purulent lesions selected for clinically suspected bacterial superinfection, all yielded bacterial growth; 35/80 (43.8%) were polymicrobial and predominantly multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacilli. Susceptibility to first-line β-lactams and fluoroquinolones was low, whereas meropenem retained activity (51/61, 84%). Lesion viral burden did not differ by HIV serostatus and showed weak correlation with HIV-1 viraemia; higher burden was associated with leucocytosis, neutrophilia with left shift, elevated CRP, and hypoalbuminaemia. Genomes clustered within Clade Ib, without segregation by HIV status or clinical severity. INTERPRETATION: Hospitalised adults with acute Clade Ib mpox in Uganda exhibited high lesion viral burden, frequent multidrug-resistant bacterial co-isolation, and an inflammatory haematological profile accentuated in participants living with HIV-1. These findings support consideration of integrating diagnostic microbiology, HIV viral load assessment, and antimicrobial stewardship into mpox case-management in endemic settings. papers.title: Real-time emotional dynamics and public discourse on Sina Weibo following the first imported mpox case in mainland China: A sentiment analysis study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The human mpox has become a significant public health threat; however, little is known about real-time public emotional responses to mpox in China. METHODS: We collected comments from the top 40 popular posts containing the keyword "Chongqing mpox" on Sina Weibo within 48 hours following the announcement of the first imported mpox case in mainland China (September 16, 2022). Using natural language processing (NLP), we applied the BosonNLP sentiment dictionary to assign emotional values (EVs) to each comment. Latent Dirichlet Allocation model was used to identify key public concerns, and Spearman correlation analysis was conducted to examine relationships between engagement metrics (comments, likes, responses) and EVs. RESULTS: The 40 popular posts received 5,107 comments, 144,940 likes, and 7,358 responses, respectively. Weibo users' comments reached a peak within two hours after the announcement (hourly data) and decreased markedly after four hours. Users with the most comments came from Guangdong, Shanghai, Beijing, Zhejiang, and Chongqing. The public was most concerned about attitudes and the transmission mode of the mpox. Sentiment analysis showed that the comments were mostly negative (76.13%). The EVs of the negative comments were 32.31 times higher than those of the positive comments. The numbers of comments, likes, and responses were all significantly associated with EVs (p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Public sentiment following the first imported mpox case in mainland China was predominantly negative and highly concentrated within the first four hours. Findings underscore the need for timely, region-sensitive risk communication during emerging outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed real-time emotional dynamics and public discourse on Sina Weibo following the first imported mpox case in mainland China. The research aimed to understand public sentiment towards mpox, as it has become a significant public health threat. The study collected comments from the top 40 posts containing the keyword "Chongqing mpox" within 48 hours of the case announcement. Using natural language processing and the BosonNLP sentiment dictionary, emotional values were assigned to comments, and a Latent Dirichlet Allocation model identified key public concerns. The results showed that comments peaked within two hours and declined after four hours, with most comments being negative (76.13%). The negative emotional values were 32.31 times higher than positive ones, and engagement metrics were significantly associated with emotional values. The authors concluded that public sentiment was predominantly negative and highly concentrated in the initial hours, highlighting the need for timely, region-sensitive risk communication during emerging mpox outbreaks. The study's findings provide insights into public health communication strategies and the importance of monitoring public discourse during outbreaks. However, the study is limited by its reliance on social media data and the potential biases of the sentiment dictionary used.

papers.title_zh: 中国大陆首例境外输入猴痘案件后新浪微博上的实时情绪动态和公众话语:情绪分析研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The human mpox has become a significant public health threat; however, little is known about real-time public emotional responses to mpox in China. METHODS: We collected comments from the top 40 popular posts containing the keyword "Chongqing mpox" on Sina Weibo within 48 hours following the announcement of the first imported mpox case in mainland China (September 16, 2022). Using natural language processing (NLP), we applied the BosonNLP sentiment dictionary to assign emotional values (EVs) to each comment. Latent Dirichlet Allocation model was used to identify key public concerns, and Spearman correlation analysis was conducted to examine relationships between engagement metrics (comments, likes, responses) and EVs. RESULTS: The 40 popular posts received 5,107 comments, 144,940 likes, and 7,358 responses, respectively. Weibo users' comments reached a peak within two hours after the announcement (hourly data) and decreased markedly after four hours. Users with the most comments came from Guangdong, Shanghai, Beijing, Zhejiang, and Chongqing. The public was most concerned about attitudes and the transmission mode of the mpox. Sentiment analysis showed that the comments were mostly negative (76.13%). The EVs of the negative comments were 32.31 times higher than those of the positive comments. The numbers of comments, likes, and responses were all significantly associated with EVs (p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Public sentiment following the first imported mpox case in mainland China was predominantly negative and highly concentrated within the first four hours. Findings underscore the need for timely, region-sensitive risk communication during emerging outbreaks.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:人类 猴痘 已成为重大的公共卫生威胁;然而,对于中国公众对 猴痘 的实时情绪反应知之甚少。方法:收集中国大陆首例输入性猴痘病例公布后48小时内(2022年9月16日)新浪微博上包含关键词“重庆猴痘”的前40条热门帖子的评论。使用自然语言处理 (NLP),我​​们应用 BosonNLP 情感词典为每条评论分配情感值 (EV)。使用潜在狄利克雷分配模型来识别关键的公众关注点,并进行 Spearman 相关分析来检查参与度指标(评论、点赞、回复)和 EV 之间的关系。结果:40 个热门帖子分别收到 5,107 条评论、144,940 条点赞和 7,358 条回复。微博用户评论在公告发布后两小时内达到峰值(每小时数据),四小时后明显下降。评论最多的用户来自广东、上海、北京、浙江和重庆。公众最关心的是猴痘的态度和猴痘模式。情绪分析显示,评论大多为负面(76.13%)。负面评论的EV是正面评论的32.31倍。评论、点赞和回复的数量均与 EV 显着相关 (p < 0.001)。结论:中国大陆首例输入性 猴痘 病例后,公众情绪主要为负面,且高度集中在前四个小时内。调查结果强调,在新兴的 暴发 期间,需要进行及时、区域敏感的风险沟通。

papers.title: Overcoming Transmission Barriers: A Dual‐Functional Adhesive Hydrogel for Direct Monkeypox Virus Neutralization and Wound Healing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The local inflammatory response and ongoing viral replication caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV) infection pose severe challenges for clinical treatment. Traditional treatment strategies are unable to achieve the dual goals of virus clearance and tissue repair simultaneously. This study innovatively adopts a hierarchical assembly strategy of “mesoporous carrier anchoring‐gel matrix embedding” to construct a functionalized hydrogel (Polymer@mPDA@Gel). Using mesoporous polydopamine (mPDA) as the exclusive anchoring site to load the polymer, forming an efficient photothermal component, and then embedding this component in a gel matrix with strong adhesion and good biocompatibility. Through hierarchical assembly, the photothermal performance, anti‐inflammatory performance, and biointerfacial properties are precisely integrated to lay the core foundation for its anti‐viral and anti‐inflammatory functions. The functionalized hydrogel constructed realizes targeted clearance of MPXV, regulation of inflammation, and integration of tissue repair, providing a new material technology path and theoretical support for the clinical treatment of MPXV infection.

papers.title_zh: 克服 传播 障碍:用于直接中和猴痘病毒和伤口愈合的双功能粘合水凝胶
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The local inflammatory response and ongoing viral replication caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV) infection pose severe challenges for clinical treatment. Traditional treatment strategies are unable to achieve the dual goals of virus clearance and tissue repair simultaneously. This study innovatively adopts a hierarchical assembly strategy of “mesoporous carrier anchoring‐gel matrix embedding” to construct a functionalized hydrogel (Polymer@mPDA@Gel). Using mesoporous polydopamine (mPDA) as the exclusive anchoring site to load the polymer, forming an efficient photothermal component, and then embedding this component in a gel matrix with strong adhesion and good biocompatibility. Through hierarchical assembly, the photothermal performance, anti‐inflammatory performance, and biointerfacial properties are precisely integrated to lay the core foundation for its anti‐viral and anti‐inflammatory functions. The functionalized hydrogel constructed realizes targeted clearance of MPXV, regulation of inflammation, and integration of tissue repair, providing a new material technology path and theoretical support for the clinical treatment of MPXV infection.

papers.title: Computational rescue of antibody binding to monkeypox virus E8L: from electrostatic repulsion to salt bridge-enhanced affinity.
papers.abstract: The ongoing Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak underscores the need for effective therapeutic antibodies. Antibody VACV-66 binds strongly to the vaccinia virus D8 protein but shows markedly reduced cross-reactivity to the MPXV homolog E8L, despite >95% sequence identity. In this study, we combined AlphaFold3 modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and ASGB-IE free energy calculations to investigate this mechanism and rationally design high-affinity antibody mutations targeting E8L. Our calculations revealed that the single N18D mutation in E8L (where N18 in D8 corresponds to D18 in E8L) introduces electrostatic repulsion with antibody residue D34 L , triggering local conformational changes that displace key residue R20 from the aromatic cage formed by W106 H and Y33 L . Based on this mechanism, saturation mutation of D34 L identified three optimal mutations (D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N) that enhance binding free energy by removing electrostatic repulsion, restoring R20 insertion into the aromatic cage, and forming new favorable interactions. Quantitative analysis of the binding free energy contributions of residues N18 and R20 across different systems provided additional support for this mechanism. This work elucidates how a single viral mutation dampens antibody cross-reactivity and provides a general computational strategy for mechanism-guided antibody optimization against emerging orthopoxviruses. The identified D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N mutants represent promising candidates for experimental validation and therapeutic development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 正在进行的 猴痘(猴痘)暴发 强调了对有效治疗抗体的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 抗体 VACV-66 与痘苗病毒 D8 蛋白强烈结合,但与 MPXV 同源物 E8L 的交叉反应性显着降低,尽管序列同一性 >95%。
elements_zh.methods: 在本研究中,我们结合AlphaFold3建模、分子动力学模拟和ASGB-IE自由能计算来研究这一机制,并合理设计针对E8L的高亲和力抗体突变。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的计算表明,E8L 中的单个 N18D 突变(其中 D8 中的 N18 对应于 E8L 中的 D18)引入了与抗体残基 D34 L 的静电排斥,引发局部构象变化,将关键残基 R20 从 W106 H 和 Y33 L 形成的芳香笼中取代。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于这一机制,D34 L的饱和突变确定了三个最佳突变(D34 L R、D34 L K和D34 L N),它们通过消除静电斥力、恢复R20插入芳香笼并形成新的有利相互作用来增强结合自由能。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 对不同系统中残基 N18 和 R20 的结合自由能贡献的定量分析为该机制提供了额外的支持。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这项工作阐明了单个病毒 突变 如何抑制抗体交叉反应性,并为针对新兴 正痘病毒 的机制引导抗体优化提供了通用计算策略。

papers.title_zh: 抗体与猴痘病毒 E8L 结合的计算拯救:从静电排斥到盐桥增强亲和力。
papers.source_body_en: The ongoing Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak underscores the need for effective therapeutic antibodies. Antibody VACV-66 binds strongly to the vaccinia virus D8 protein but shows markedly reduced cross-reactivity to the MPXV homolog E8L, despite >95% sequence identity. In this study, we combined AlphaFold3 modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and ASGB-IE free energy calculations to investigate this mechanism and rationally design high-affinity antibody mutations targeting E8L. Our calculations revealed that the single N18D mutation in E8L (where N18 in D8 corresponds to D18 in E8L) introduces electrostatic repulsion with antibody residue D34 L , triggering local conformational changes that displace key residue R20 from the aromatic cage formed by W106 H and Y33 L . Based on this mechanism, saturation mutation of D34 L identified three optimal mutations (D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N) that enhance binding free energy by removing electrostatic repulsion, restoring R20 insertion into the aromatic cage, and forming new favorable interactions. Quantitative analysis of the binding free energy contributions of residues N18 and R20 across different systems provided additional support for this mechanism. This work elucidates how a single viral mutation dampens antibody cross-reactivity and provides a general computational strategy for mechanism-guided antibody optimization against emerging orthopoxviruses. The identified D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N mutants represent promising candidates for experimental validation and therapeutic development.
papers.abstract_zh: 正在进行的 猴痘(猴痘)暴发 强调了对有效治疗抗体的需求。抗体 VACV-66 与痘苗病毒 D8 蛋白强烈结合,但与 MPXV 同源物 E8L 的交叉反应性显着降低,尽管序列同一性 >95%。在本研究中,我们结合AlphaFold3建模、分子动力学模拟和ASGB-IE自由能计算来研究这一机制,并合理设计针对E8L的高亲和力抗体突变。我们的计算表明,E8L 中的单个 N18D 突变(其中 D8 中的 N18 对应于 E8L 中的 D18)引入了与抗体残基 D34 L 的静电排斥,引发局部构象变化,将关键残基 R20 从 W106 H 和 Y33 L 形成的芳香笼中取代。基于这一机制,D34 L的饱和突变确定了三个最佳突变(D34 L R、D34 L K和D34 L N),它们通过消除静电斥力、恢复R20插入芳香笼并形成新的有利相互作用来增强结合自由能。对不同系统中残基 N18 和 R20 的结合自由能贡献的定量分析为该机制提供了额外的支持。这项工作阐明了单个病毒 突变 如何抑制抗体交叉反应性,并为针对新兴 正痘病毒 的机制引导抗体优化提供了通用计算策略。已鉴定的 D34 L R、D34 L K 和 D34 L N 突变体代表了实验验证和治疗开发的有希望的候选者。

papers.title: Mpox in Europe, 2022–2026: A Scoping Review of Viral Clades, Host Determinants of Severity and Antiviral Therapy
papers.abstract: The 2022–2024 mpox outbreak in Europe was dominated by MPXV Clade IIb and generally mild, but recent Clade I/Ib detections and early local transmission have changed preparedness needs. We performed a PRISMA-ScR scoping review of European mpox evidence from 2022 to 2026, supplemented by global and African data where regional evidence was sparse, covering clades, host determinants of severe disease, and antiviral efficacy and resistance, and ranking the evidence gaps. European Clade IIb surveillance showed very low mortality (10 deaths among 22,662 cases; case fatality 0.04%), contrasting with 3–11% estimates for Clade I/Ib in affected African settings, although comparisons are confounded by age, health-system access and comorbidity. Severe European disease was driven mainly by immune compromise: non-HIV immunosuppression, uncontrolled HIV and CD4 counts < 200 cells/μL were the most consistent markers, while women were a small minority of cases, with higher hospitalisation risk, especially in pregnancy. Tecovirimat failed to improve outcomes in four randomised trials, F13L-associated resistance was reported in advanced HIV, and its European mpox use was subsequently restricted. The evidence base is strongest for mild Clade IIb infection in immunocompetent adults and weakest for the groups most likely to need treatment. Preparedness should prioritise harmonised genomic surveillance, severity-stratified cohort data and adaptive therapeutic trials enrolling immunocompromised, paediatric, pregnant and older patients.

papers.title_original: Mpox in Europe, 2022–2026: A Scoping Review of Viral Clades, Host Determinants of Severity and Antiviral Therapy

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Mpox virus (MPXV), specifically examining viral clades, host determinants of disease severity, and antiviral therapy efficacy in Europe from 2022 to 2026. The central question is to understand the epidemiology, clinical features, and treatment options of mpox in this region, with an emphasis on clade-specific differences and host-related risk factors.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A PRISMA-ScR scoping review was conducted using European mpox evidence from 2022 to 2026, supplemented by global and African data where regional evidence was sparse. The review aimed to cover MPXV clades, host determinants of severe disease, and antiviral efficacy and resistance, while also identifying evidence gaps.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The 2022–2024 mpox outbreak in Europe was dominated by MPXV Clade IIb, with very low mortality (0.04%). However, recent detections of Clade I/Ib and early local transmission have raised concerns. Severe disease in Europe was primarily associated with immune compromise, including non-HIV immunosuppression, uncontrolled HIV, and low CD4 counts. Women, especially pregnant individuals, showed a higher hospitalisation risk.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Comparisons between European and African mpox outcomes are confounded by factors such as age, health-system access, and comorbidity. There is limited evidence on the efficacy of tecovirimat in Clade I/Ib infections, and its use in Europe was restricted due to reported resistance. The evidence base is strongest for mild Clade IIb infections in immunocompetent adults and weakest for groups most likely to require treatment.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Preparedness should prioritize harmonized genomic surveillance, severity-stratified cohort data, and adaptive therapeutic trials that include immunocompromised, pediatric, pregnant, and older patients. Further research is needed to understand the clinical outcomes of Clade I/Ib infections and to develop targeted interventions for high-risk groups.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review examines the Mpox virus (MPXV) in Europe from 2022 to 2026, focusing on viral clades, host determinants of disease severity, and antiviral therapy. The outbreak was dominated by Clade IIb, associated with mild cases and low mortality, but recent Clade I/Ib detections and local transmission have altered preparedness needs. Severe disease was linked to immune compromise, with women and pregnant individuals showing higher hospitalization risks. Tecovirimat failed to improve outcomes in trials, and resistance was reported in advanced HIV. The evidence base is strongest for Clade IIb in immunocompetent adults but weakest for high-risk groups. The review highlights the need for harmonized genomic surveillance, severity-stratified data, and adaptive therapeutic trials to address gaps in understanding and treatment.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注猴痘病毒(MPXV),专门检查2022年至2026年欧洲的病毒进化枝、疾病严重程度的宿主决定因素以及抗病毒药物治疗效果。中心问题是了解流行病学、临床特征和猴痘在该地区的治疗选择,重点是分支特异性差异和 宿主 相关风险因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 使用 2022 年至 2026 年欧洲 猴痘 证据进行了 PRISMA-ScR 范围界定审查,并辅以区域证据稀少的全球和非洲数据。该综述旨在涵盖 MPXV 进化枝、严重疾病的 宿主 决定因素以及 抗病毒药物 疗效和耐药性,同时还确定证据差距。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 欧洲 2022-2024 年 猴痘 暴发 由 MPXV Clade IIb 主导,死亡率 非常低(0.04%)。然而,最近检测到的 Clade I/Ib 和早期本地 传播 引起了人们的担忧。欧洲的严重疾病主要与免疫受损有关,包括非 HIV 免疫抑制、不受控制的 HIV 和低 CD4 计数。女性,尤其是孕妇,表现出更高的住院风险。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 欧洲和非洲 猴痘 结果之间的比较受到年龄、卫生系统可及性和合并症等因素的影响。关于 特考韦瑞 对 Clade I/Ib 感染的疗效的证据有限,并且由于报告的耐药性,其在欧洲的使用受到限制。对于免疫功能正常的成年人中轻度 Clade IIb 感染的证据基础最强,而对于最有可能需要 治疗 的群体来说证据基础最弱。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Mpox virus (MPXV), specifically examining viral clades, host determinants of disease severity, and antiviral therapy efficacy in Europe from 2022 to 2026. The central question is to understand the epidemiology, clinical features, and treatment options of mpox in this region, with an emphasis on clade-specific differences and host-related risk factors.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A PRISMA-ScR scoping review was conducted using European mpox evidence from 2022 to 2026, supplemented by global and African data where regional evidence was sparse. analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The 2022–2024 mpox outbreak in Europe was dominated by MPXV Clade IIb, with very low mortality (0.04%). However, recent detections of Clade I/Ib and early local transmission have raised concerns. Severe disease in Europe was primarily associated with immune compromise, including non-HIV immunosuppression, uncontrolled HIV, and low CD4 counts. Women, especially pregnant individuals, showed a higher hospitalisation risk.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Comparisons between European and African mpox outcomes are confounded by factors such as age, health-system access, and comorbidity. papers.title_zh: 欧洲的 猴痘,2022-2026 年:病毒进化枝的范围界定审查、宿主 严重程度的决定因素和 抗病毒药物 治疗
papers.source_body_en: The 2022–2024 mpox outbreak in Europe was dominated by MPXV Clade IIb and generally mild, but recent Clade I/Ib detections and early local transmission have changed preparedness needs. papers.title: An in-depth comparison: first wave of mpox in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and Lisbon, Portugal
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The 2022 mpox outbreak spread rapidly beyond endemic regions, affecting multiple countries with broadly similar transmission patterns but different public health responses and surveillance systems. We compared laboratory-confirmed mpox infections reported during the first epidemic wave in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and Lisbon, Portugal, with particular attention to demographic characteristics, clinical presentation, transmission patterns, hospitalization, and the role of HIV status. Methods We conducted a retrospective analysis of routinely collected, deidentified surveillance data from national notification systems in Brazil and Portugal. Adults with laboratory-confirmed mpox reported between May and December 2022 were included. Variables were harmonized across datasets, and missing data were retained without imputation. Descriptive analyses were performed by city and HIV status. Group comparisons used Pearson’s chi-square test, Fisher’s exact test, Mann-Whitney U test, and two proportion Z tests, as appropriate. Data completeness was also explored. Results A total of 1,614 individuals were included: 960 from Rio de Janeiro and 654 from Lisbon. Mean age was similar in both cities (34.5 vs 34.9 years), but Lisbon had a higher proportion of males (99.4% vs 93.0%). The epidemic curves showed a similar rise-and-decline pattern, with an earlier peak in Lisbon (June 2022) and a later peak in Rio de Janeiro (August 2022). Skin or mucosal lesions were the most frequently reported manifestation in both settings, affecting more than 85% of individuals. Fever was reported more often in Rio de Janeiro, whereas adenopathy and asthenia were more commonly recorded in Lisbon. Within each city, symptom profiles were not significantly different between people living with HIV and those not living with HIV. Hospitalization rates were low overall in both cities (5.7% in Rio de Janeiro and 5.4% in Lisbon), although people living with HIV in Rio de Janeiro had higher odds of hospitalization than those without HIV. Data completeness was generally better in Rio de Janeiro than in Lisbon. Conclusions Rio de Janeiro and Lisbon experienced similarly shaped first wave mpox epidemics, despite differences in timing, surveillance completeness, and health system context. HIV status did not appear to meaningfully modify acute clinical presentation, while hospitalization risk may have been influenced by differences in immune status and care pathways. These findings highlight the importance of harmonized, high-quality surveillance to support more accurate cross-country comparisons and better targeted public health responses.

papers.title_zh: 深度对比:巴西里约热内卢和葡萄牙里斯本第一波猴痘
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background The 2022 mpox outbreak spread rapidly beyond endemic regions, affecting multiple countries with broadly similar transmission patterns but different public health responses and surveillance systems. We compared laboratory-confirmed mpox infections reported during the first epidemic wave in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and Lisbon, Portugal, with particular attention to demographic characteristics, clinical presentation, transmission patterns, hospitalization, and the role of HIV status. Methods We conducted a retrospective analysis of routinely collected, deidentified surveillance data from national notification systems in Brazil and Portugal. Adults with laboratory-confirmed mpox reported between May and December 2022 were included. Variables were harmonized across datasets, and missing data were retained without imputation. Descriptive analyses were performed by city and HIV status. Group comparisons used Pearson’s chi-square test, Fisher’s exact test, Mann-Whitney U test, and two proportion Z tests, as appropriate. Data completeness was also explored. Results A total of 1,614 individuals were included: 960 from Rio de Janeiro and 654 from Lisbon. Mean age was similar in both cities (34.5 vs 34.9 years), but Lisbon had a higher proportion of males (99.4% vs 93.0%). The epidemic curves showed a similar rise-and-decline pattern, with an earlier peak in Lisbon (June 2022) and a later peak in Rio de Janeiro (August 2022). Skin or mucosal lesions were the most frequently reported manifestation in both settings, affecting more than 85% of individuals. Fever was reported more often in Rio de Janeiro, whereas adenopathy and asthenia were more commonly recorded in Lisbon. Within each city, symptom profiles were not significantly different between people living with HIV and those not living with HIV. Hospitalization rates were low overall in both cities (5.7% in Rio de Janeiro and 5.4% in Lisbon), although people living with HIV in Rio de Janeiro had higher odds of hospitalization than those without HIV. Data completeness was generally better in Rio de Janeiro than in Lisbon. Conclusions Rio de Janeiro and Lisbon experienced similarly shaped first wave mpox epidemics, despite differences in timing, surveillance completeness, and health system context. HIV status did not appear to meaningfully modify acute clinical presentation, while hospitalization risk may have been influenced by differences in immune status and care pathways. These findings highlight the importance of harmonized, high-quality surveillance to support more accurate cross-country comparisons and better targeted public health responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 2022 年 猴痘 暴发 迅速蔓延到流行地区以外,影响了 传播 模式大致相似但公共卫生应对和 监测 系统不同的多个国家。我们比较了巴西里约热内卢和葡萄牙里斯本第一波疫情期间报告的实验室确诊的 猴痘 感染,特别关注人口特征、临床表现、猴痘 模式、住院情况和 HIV 状态的作用。方法 我们对巴西和葡萄牙国家通报系统定期收集的去识别化 监测 数据进行了回顾性分析。2022 年 5 月至 12 月期间报告的经实验室确诊为 猴痘 的成年人也被纳入其中。跨数据集的变量得到了协调,缺失的数据被保留而无需插补。按城市和艾滋病毒状况进行描述性分析。组比较酌情使用 Pearson 卡方检验、Fisher 精确检验、Mann-Whitney U 检验和两个比例 Z 检验。还探讨了数据完整性。结果 总共纳入 1,614 人:960 人来自里约热内卢,654 人来自里斯本。两个城市的平均年龄相似(34.5 岁 vs 34.9 岁),但里斯本的男性比例更高(99.4% vs 93.0%)。疫情曲线显示出类似的上升和下降模式,里斯本的峰值较早(2022年6月),里约热内卢的峰值较晚(2022年8月)。皮肤或粘膜病变是这两种情况下最常报告的表现,影响超过 85% 的个体。里约热内卢更常报告发烧,而里斯本更常报告淋巴结病和乏力。在每个城市内,艾滋病毒感染者和非艾滋病毒感染者的症状特征没有显着差异。两个城市的住院率总体较低(里约热内卢为 5.7%,里斯本为 5.4%),尽管里约热内卢的艾滋病毒感染者住院几率高于未感染艾滋病毒的人。里约热内卢的数据完整性总体上好于里斯本。结论 里约热内卢和里斯本经历了类似的第一波 猴痘 流行病,尽管时间、监测 完整性和卫生系统背景存在差异。HIV 状态似乎并未显着改变急性临床表现,而住院风险可能受到免疫状态和护理途径差异的影响。这些发现强调了协调一致的高质量 监测 对于支持更准确的跨国比较和更有针对性的公共卫生应对措施的重要性。

papers.title: Psychometric properties of an instrument measuring monkeypox knowledge, perception, and beliefs of health threat in health science students in a middle-income country
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to establish the factor structure and reliability of the evaluation instrument measuring monkeypox (Mpox) knowledge, perception and beliefs of health threat in students of the health area in two universities of Peru during 2022. Methods The methodology used was psychometric in nature. The study variable on knowledge of Mpox was assessed using a 17-item questionnaire developed by Ricco et al., originally applied to health professionals, adapted to Peruvian context, and administered to 416 students. Results The results showed adequate goodness-of-fit indicators, with RMSEA and SRMR values below 0.08 and a TLI above 0.90, confirming an acceptable model fit. Reliability was adequate for knowledge of Mpox (KR20 = 0.70 and α = 0.73), with perception of health threats showing the highest reliability (α = 0.88 and Ω = 0.89). Conclusions The instrument demonstrated an adequate factor structure and acceptable reliability for measuring Mpox knowledge, perception, and health threat beliefs in Peruvian health students, supporting its applicability in future research and public health interventions.

papers.title_zh: 测量中等收入国家健康科学学生的猴痘知识、感知和健康威胁信念的仪器的心理测量特性
papers.source_body_en: Objective: This study aimed to establish the factor structure and reliability of the evaluation instrument measuring monkeypox (Mpox) knowledge, perception and beliefs of health threat in students of the health area in two universities of Peru during 2022. Methods The methodology used was psychometric in nature. The study variable on knowledge of Mpox was assessed using a 17-item questionnaire developed by Ricco et al., originally applied to health professionals, adapted to Peruvian context, and administered to 416 students. Results The results showed adequate goodness-of-fit indicators, with RMSEA and SRMR values below 0.08 and a TLI above 0.90, confirming an acceptable model fit. Reliability was adequate for knowledge of Mpox (KR20 = 0.70 and α = 0.73), with perception of health threats showing the highest reliability (α = 0.88 and Ω = 0.89). Conclusions The instrument demonstrated an adequate factor structure and acceptable reliability for measuring Mpox knowledge, perception, and health threat beliefs in Peruvian health students, supporting its applicability in future research and public health interventions.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本研究旨在建立 2022 年秘鲁两所大学卫生领域学生健康威胁知识、感知和信念测量猴痘(猴痘)评估工具的因子结构和可靠性。方法使用的方法本质上是心理测量。关于 猴痘 知识的研究变量是使用 Ricco 等人开发的包含 17 项的调查问卷进行评估的,该调查问卷最初适用于卫生专业人员,后来适应了秘鲁的情况,并针对 416 名学生进行了调查。结果 结果显示了足够的拟合优度指标,RMSEA 和 SRMR 值低于 0.08,TLI 高于 0.90,证实了可接受的模型拟合。猴痘 知识的可靠性足够(KR20 = 0.70 和 α = 0.73),对健康威胁的感知显示出最高的可靠性(α = 0.88 和 Ω = 0.89)。结论 该仪器在测量秘鲁健康学生的 猴痘 知识、感知和健康威胁信念方面表现出足够的因素结构和可接受的可靠性,支持其在未来研究和公共卫生干预中的适用性。

papers.title: Virtual Screening of Bacteriocins From Lactic Acid Bacteria Against Monkeypox DNA Polymerase: Sakacin P and Mundticin KS Emerge as Promising Candidates.
papers.abstract: The monkeypox virus (MPXV) has recently risen to be a significant global health threat and currently there are no approved antiviral agents, which makes it necessary to develop new antiviral strategies. In this study, we employed in silico techniques to investigate whether bacteriocins could be potent inhibitors of the MPXV DNA polymerase (MPDP). At first, the MPXV DNA polymerase enzyme chain was extracted from the Cryo-EM structure of MPXV DNA replication complex and was then assessed using SWISS-MODEL/QMEAN for structural quality. The structures of selected bacteriocins were either retrieved from the Protein Data Bank or predicted using AlphaFold. The quality of these predicted models was measured by LGscore. Moreover, the physicochemical properties of the selected bacteriocins, such as Sakacin P and Mundticin KS, were analyzed to assess their molecular stability and compatibility with the molecular docking process. The results of protein-peptide docking simulations on the HADDOCK platform showed that among all the bacteriocins tested, Sakacin P and Mundticin KS had the highest binding affinities toward MPXV DNA polymerase. The analysis of the docking experiments also revealed vital stabilizing interactions, such as the formation of hydrogen bonds, ionic linkages, and π-π stacking, which were crucial in the strength of the protein-ligand complexes. Subsequently, the molecular dynamics (MD) simulations further confirmed the stability of the protein-bacteriocin complexes. Our results indicate that bacteriocins, especially Sakacin P and Mundticin KS, can be considered potential antiviral agents against MPXV by interfering with its DNA replication mechanism. The present work shall serve as a reference for future laboratory testing and for the promising innovation of bacteriocin-based drugs targeting MPXV.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the urgent public-health need for antiviral agents against monkeypox virus (MPXV), which currently lacks approved treatments, by asking whether bacteriocins can inhibit the viral DNA polymerase.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors conducted an in silico investigation using computational modeling and docking to evaluate bacteriocins as potential inhibitors of the MPXV DNA polymerase.
analysis.methods: The MPXV DNA polymerase structure was extracted from a Cryo-EM replication complex and assessed with SWISS-MODEL/QMEAN; bacteriocin structures were retrieved from the Protein Data Bank or predicted with AlphaFold, and their quality was measured by LGscore.
analysis.main_results: Protein-peptide docking on the HADDOCK platform showed that Sakacin P and Mundticin KS had the highest binding affinities to MPXV DNA polymerase, with stabilizing interactions including hydrogen bonds, ionic linkages, and π-π stacking.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that Sakacin P and Mundticin KS may interfere with MPXV DNA replication, proposing them as promising antiviral candidates and calling for future laboratory validation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest bacteriocin-based drugs targeting MPXV DNA polymerase could inform antiviral development and future surveillance strategies, pending experimental confirmation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in silico predictions without experimental validation, relying on computational models and docking scores, which lowers confidence and generalizability.

analysis.summary_en: This in silico study evaluated bacteriocins as potential inhibitors of monkeypox virus (MPXV) DNA polymerase due to the absence of approved antivirals. The authors extracted the polymerase structure from Cryo-EM data, modeled bacteriocin structures via AlphaFold or retrieved them from databases, and performed docking simulations on HADDOCK. Sakacin P and Mundticin KS showed the highest binding affinities with stabilizing interactions, and molecular dynamics simulations supported complex stability. The authors propose these bacteriocins as promising antiviral candidates against MPXV by interfering with DNA replication, advocating for future laboratory testing. However, the findings are computational and require experimental validation to confirm antiviral efficacy and safety.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过询问细菌素是否可以抑制病毒 DNA 聚合酶,解决了针对猴痘病毒(MPXV)的 抗病毒药物 药物的迫切公共卫生需求,目前该病毒缺乏批准的 治疗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作者利用计算模型和对接进行了一项计算机研究,以评估细菌素作为 MPXV DNA 聚合酶的潜在抑制剂。
elements_zh.methods: 从 Cryo-EM 复制复合物中提取 MPXV DNA 聚合酶结构,并使用 SWISS-MODEL/QMEAN 进行评估;细菌素结构从蛋白质数据库中检索或使用 AlphaFold 预测,并通过 LGscore 测量其质量。
elements_zh.main_results: HADDOCK平台上的蛋白-肽对接表明,Sakacin P和Mundticin KS对MPXV DNA聚合酶具有最高的结合亲和力,具有包括氢键、离子键和π-π堆积在内的稳定相互作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 Sakacin P 和 Mundticin KS 可能干扰 MPXV DNA 复制的证据,提出它们作为有前途的 抗病毒药物 候选药物,并呼吁未来进行实验室验证。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,针对 MPXV DNA 聚合酶的基于细菌素的药物可以为 抗病毒药物 的开发和未来的 监测 策略提供信息,有待实验证实。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于未经实验验证的计算机预测,依赖于计算模型和对接分数,这降低了置信度和普遍性。

papers.title_zh: 针对猴痘 DNA 聚合酶的乳酸菌细菌素的虚拟筛选:Sakacin P 和 Mundticin KS 成为有前途的候选药物。
papers.source_body_en: The monkeypox virus (MPXV) has recently risen to be a significant global health threat and currently there are no approved antiviral agents, which makes it necessary to develop new antiviral strategies. In this study, we employed in silico techniques to investigate whether bacteriocins could be potent inhibitors of the MPXV DNA polymerase (MPDP). At first, the MPXV DNA polymerase enzyme chain was extracted from the Cryo-EM structure of MPXV DNA replication complex and was then assessed using SWISS-MODEL/QMEAN for structural quality. The structures of selected bacteriocins were either retrieved from the Protein Data Bank or predicted using AlphaFold. The quality of these predicted models was measured by LGscore. Moreover, the physicochemical properties of the selected bacteriocins, such as Sakacin P and Mundticin KS, were analyzed to assess their molecular stability and compatibility with the molecular docking process. The results of protein-peptide docking simulations on the HADDOCK platform showed that among all the bacteriocins tested, Sakacin P and Mundticin KS had the highest binding affinities toward MPXV DNA polymerase. The analysis of the docking experiments also revealed vital stabilizing interactions, such as the formation of hydrogen bonds, ionic linkages, and π-π stacking, which were crucial in the strength of the protein-ligand complexes. Subsequently, the molecular dynamics (MD) simulations further confirmed the stability of the protein-bacteriocin complexes. Our results indicate that bacteriocins, especially Sakacin P and Mundticin KS, can be considered potential antiviral agents against MPXV by interfering with its DNA replication mechanism. The present work shall serve as a reference for future laboratory testing and for the promising innovation of bacteriocin-based drugs targeting MPXV.

papers.title: Knowledge and Readiness for Mpox Among Primary Healthcare Workers in Malaysia and Their Associated Factors: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Mpox has re-emerged as a public health concern, highlighting the need to strengthen frontline preparedness. Primary healthcare workers require adequate knowledge to recognise symptoms, understand transmission, differentiate mpox from other conditions, and follow appropriate management protocols. They must also be prepared to implement appropriate infection prevention and control measures. This study aimed to assess knowledge and readiness regarding mpox management among primary healthcare workers in Malaysia and identify associated factors. A newly developed questionnaire underwent content and face validation, followed by psychometric evaluation using two-parameter logistic item response theory for the knowledge domain and exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis for the readiness domain. The questionnaire was then administered in a cross-sectional study among 333 primary healthcare workers in Malaysia. The total knowledge and readiness scores were converted to percentage scores. Descriptive statistics and linear regression analyses were conducted. Mean percentage scores were 78.0% for knowledge and 75.5% for readiness. Among the readiness domains, attitude towards mpox management had the highest mean percentage score (88.8%), followed by intention to take action (81.0%), perceived behavioural control (65.4%), and perceived risk (45.9%). The knowledge score was significantly associated with the presence of a medical illness (adjusted β = -1.01; 95% CI: -1.73, -0.30; p = 0.006), being a medical assistant (adjusted β = -1.62; 95% CI: -2.36, -0.87; p < 0.001) or nurse (adjusted β = -1.32; 95% CI: -2.05, -0.59; p < 0.001), attendance at an mpox-related course (adjusted β = 1.31; 95% CI: 0.43, 2.19; p = 0.004), and the readiness score (adjusted β = 0.14; 95% CI: 0.11, 0.18; p < 0.001). The readiness score was significantly associated with having a master’s degree (adjusted β = 5.76; 95% CI: 0.11, 11.41; p = 0.046), being a medical assistant (adjusted β = 4.54; 95% CI: 1.37, 7.72; p = 0.005) or nurse (adjusted β = 3.28; 95% CI: 0.01, 6.55; p = 0.049), working in a clinic with a moderate (adjusted β = 2.76; 95% CI: 0.76, 4.77; p = 0.007) or high workload (adjusted β = 2.44; 95% CI: 0.26, 4.63; p = 0.029), previous experience managing suspected mpox cases (adjusted β = 3.53; 95% CI: 0.36, 6.70; p = 0.029), and the knowledge score (adjusted β = 0.87; 95% CI: 0.61, 1.13; p < 0.001). Primary healthcare workers demonstrated relatively favourable mean scores for knowledge and overall readiness regarding mpox management, although gaps remained in specific knowledge areas, perceived behavioural control, and perceived risk. These findings may help health authorities develop profession-specific training to address the identified gaps and routinely monitor frontline preparedness using the validated questionnaire.

papers.title: CRISPR-Cas12a-based fluorescent and visual assays for universal detection and clade discrimination of mpox virus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The global mpox outbreak has highlighted critical gaps in diagnostic capabilities, particularly the need for methods that can distinguish between the high-fatality Clade I and more transmissible Clade II of the mpox virus (MPXV). Current PCR-based approaches remain reliant on laboratory infrastructure, limiting their use in resource-limited settings. There is an urgent need for a versatile diagnostic platform that can provide both accurate clade discrimination and flexible deployment across diverse healthcare environments. We developed a dual-mode detection platform by integrating recombinase-aided amplification with Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats-Cas12a technology, creating two distinct assays: a universal assay targeting OPG034, and a Clade I-discriminatory assay targeting OPG033. The platform achieved detection sensitivities of 1 copy/reaction for both fluorescence and visual readouts with OPG034, and 10 copies (fluorescence) and 1 copy/reaction (visual) with OPG033. Both assays demonstrated high specificity, successfully distinguishing MPXV from related orthopoxviruses and common viruses. Clinical validation using 23 Clade II samples and 10 healthy controls showed that, relative to quantitative PCR (qPCR) (cycle threshold ≤37), the OPG034 fluorescence assay detected all 13 qPCR-positive samples and 2 additional positives (100% sensitivity, 80.0% specificity), while the visual assay detected 12 of 13 positives (92.3% sensitivity, 100% specificity). For Clade I-specific detection, both OPG033 fluorescence and visual assays showed 100% specificity in Clade II samples (23/23). While the clade-discriminatory capability was established through sequence-specific design, further evaluation with authentic Clade I clinical specimens is warranted to confirm typing performance. The dual-mode design provides flexibility for both laboratory and field use, advancing mpox surveillance and outbreak response. IMPORTANCE Mpox is a significant zoonosis. Accurate discrimination between its highly lethal Clade I and more transmissible Clade II is critical for clinical management and outbreak control, yet current methods primarily enable only general detection. To address this, we identified novel genetic markers (OPG034 for universal detection and OPG033 for Clade I specificity) and developed a dual-mode detection platform integrating Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats-Cas12a with recombinase-aided amplification. Its key advantage is providing two result readouts: a sensitive fluorescence mode for laboratories and an instrument-free visual colorimetric mode for field use. The demonstrated excellent performance on clinical samples confirms that this platform meets the precision requirements of clinical laboratories while remaining suitable for resource-limited settings like field clinics. Thus, it offers a flexible and practical tool for enhancing mpox surveillance and control globally, particularly in regions with constrained medical resources.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们开发了一个双模式检测平台,将重组酶辅助扩增与成簇规则间隔短回文重复序列-Cas12a技术相结合,创建了两种不同的检测方法:针对 OPG034 的通用检测方法和针对 OPG033 的 Clade I 判别检测方法。

elements_zh.main_results: 两种检测均表现出高度特异性,成功地将 MPXV 与相关的 正痘病毒 和常见病毒区分开来。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该平台使用 OPG034 实现了荧光和视觉读数 1 个拷贝/反应的检测灵敏度,使用 OPG033 实现了 10 个拷贝(荧光)和 1 个拷贝/反应(视觉)的检测灵敏度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在临床样本上表现出的优异性能证实了该平台满足临床实验室的精度要求,同时仍然适用于现场诊所等资源有限的环境。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 其主要优点是提供两种结果读数:适用于实验室的灵敏荧光模式和适用于现场使用的无仪器视觉比色模式。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:全球 猴痘 暴发 强调了诊断能力的关键差距,特别是需要能够区分 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 的高致死性分支 I 和更具传染性的分支 II 的方法。目前基于 PCR 的方法仍然依赖于实验室基础设施,限制了它们在资源有限的环境中的使用。迫切需要一种多功能诊断平台,既可以提供准确的进化枝区分,又可以在不同的医疗环境中灵活部署。我们开发了一个双模式检测平台,将重组酶辅助扩增与成簇规则间隔短回文重复序列-Cas12a技术相结合,创建了两种不同的检测方法:针对 OPG034 的通用检测方法和针对 OPG033 的 Clade I 判别检测方法。该平台使用 OPG034 实现了荧光和视觉读数 1 个拷贝/反应的检测灵敏度,使用 OPG033 实现了 10 个拷贝(荧光)和 1 个拷贝/反应(视觉)的检测灵敏度。两种检测均表现出高度特异性,成功地将 MPXV 与相关的 正痘病毒 和常见病毒区分开来。使用 23 个 Clade II 样本和 10 个健康对照进行的临床验证表明,相对于定量 PCR (qPCR)(循环阈值≤37),OPG034 荧光检测检测到了所有 13 个 qPCR 阳性样本和 2 个额外的阳性样本(100% 敏感性,80.0% 特异性),而视觉检测检测到 13 个阳性中的 12 个(敏感性 92.3%,100% 特异性)。对于 Clade I 特异性检测,OPG033 荧光和视觉检测在 Clade II 样品中均显示 100% 特异性 (23/23)。虽然进化枝区分能力是通过序列特异性设计建立的,但有必要使用真实的进化枝 I 临床标本进行进一步评估,以确认分型性能。双模式设计为​​实验室和现场使​​用提供了灵活性,提高了 猴痘 监测 和 暴发 响应能力。重要性 猴痘 是重要的 人兽共患病。准确区分其高致命性的 Clade I 和更具传染性的 Clade II 对于临床管理和 暴发 控制至关重要,但目前的方法主要只能进行一般检测。为了解决这个问题,我们鉴定了新的遗传标记(用于通用检测的 OPG034 和用于 Clade I 特异性的 OPG033),并开发了一种将成簇规则间隔短回文重复序列-Cas12a 与重组酶辅助扩增相结合的双模式检测平台。其主要优点是提供两种结果读数:适用于实验室的灵敏荧光模式和适用于现场使用的无仪器视觉比色模式。在临床样本上表现出的优异性能证实了该平台满足临床实验室的精度要求,同时仍然适用于现场诊所等资源有限的环境。因此,它为增强 猴痘 监测 和全球控制提供了灵活实用的工具,特别是在医疗资源有限的地区。

papers.title: Antifolate agent aminopterin demonstrates potent anti-monkeypox virus activity in vitro and in vivo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The ongoing spread of the monkeypox outbreak underscores the urgent need for the development of effective therapeutics against the monkeypox virus (MPXV). Aminopterin is a classical antifolate agent known for its anti-tumor activity through the inhibition of folate metabolism. Here, aminopterin was identified as an effective anti-MPXV agent. It significantly inhibited MPXV replication, unlike other antifolate agents such as methotrexate, pemetrexed, and LSN3213218. In Vero E6 cells, the half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) was 36.10 nM, the half-cytotoxic concentration (CC50) was 3,310 nM, and the selectivity index (SI) was 91.690. In human foreskin fibroblast cells, the IC 50 was 32.73 nM, CC50 exceeded 10 μM, and SI was greater than 305.530. In vivo , aminopterin not only inhibited MPXV infection but also mitigated high-dose viral infection-associated inflammation. Furthermore, the data indicated that aminopterin reduced viral load by interfering with viral attachment and replication. Together, these findings identify aminopterin as a promising candidate for anti-MPXV drug development. IMPORTANCE The urgent need for effective monkeypox virus (MPXV) therapeutics is underscored by the ongoing outbreak. This study identifies aminopterin as a potent anti‐MPXV agent among four antifolate agents. Crucially, aminopterin suppresses viral infection and mitigates infection-associated inflammation in vivo . These findings position aminopterin as a potential candidate for the development of an antiviral agent against MPXV.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the antiviral potential of aminopterin against the monkeypox virus (MPXV). The ongoing monkeypox outbreak highlights the need for effective therapeutics, and the research identifies aminopterin as a potent anti-MPXV agent. However, the study is limited to laboratory models, and further clinical validation is required. The evidence is strong based on direct antiviral activity and selectivity, but the findings cannot be generalized to human clinical settings without additional research.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that nurse-led intradermal administration could be a valuable strategy for improving vaccine delivery in mpox response efforts, particularly in resource-limited environments.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is limited to a single county health department, which may affect generalizability. The confidence in the findings is moderate due to the lack of broader data.

The findings suggest that nurse-led intradermal administration could be beneficial for mpox management, particularly in resource-limited areas. However, the study's scope is limited to a single health department, which may restrict the generalizability of the results. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to these limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估护士主导的公共卫生应对措施在管理 猴痘 暴发 方面的有效性。背景强调需要有效且可扩展的策略来解决社区环境中的 猴痘 问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在一个县卫生部门进行的,重点关注被诊断为 猴痘 的患者。该人群包括在特定时期内通过护士主导的举措接受护理的个人。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及过渡到皮内给药,作为护士主导反应的一部分。实施这种方法是为了提高 疫苗 交付效率并减少浪费。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,向皮内给药的过渡已成功实施,没有发现任何不良反应。没有具体说明通过这种方法接种疫苗的患者的确切人数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了护士主导的皮内给药在管理 猴痘 暴发 方面的可行性。这种方法在公共卫生环境中的应用是新颖的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,护士主导的皮内给药可能是改善 疫苗 响应工作中 疫苗 递送的有价值的策略,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据仅限于单个县卫生部门,这可能会影响普遍性。由于缺乏更广泛的数据,研究结果的可信度较低。

papers.title: Engineering Organoid Platforms for Pathogenesis Research.
papers.abstract: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases ranging from the 1918 H1N1 influenza pandemic to the recent SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus outbreaks continue to pose profound threats to global public health. These crises underscore the critical need for high-fidelity and human-relevant infection models. Organoid technology has emerged as a cornerstone platform for pathogen research by faithfully recapitulating the 3-dimensional architecture and physiological microenvironment of native human tissues in vitro. This review systematically examines the development and structural refinement of organoid-based infection models with an emphasis on evidence-based strategies for stem cell source selection, extracellular matrix optimization, and dynamic culture system engineering. Such advancements enable the robust generation of multi-organ models including respiratory, intestinal, and neural organoids tailored for investigating viral tropism, spatiotemporal infection kinetics, and host immune responses. Furthermore, we evaluate the translational utility of organoids in high-throughput antiviral drug screening and preclinical vaccine assessment. To further enhance physiological relevance and functional fidelity, organoid platforms are being increasingly combined with advanced engineering strategies, including coculture approaches, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated genetic perturbation, engineered microphysiological systems (such as organ-on-a-chip), and 3D bioprinting. These integrated technologies improve biomimicry while expanding experimental controllability and scalability. In addition, we critically examine the major bottlenecks limiting clinical translation and discuss emerging frontiers driven by artificial intelligence and synthetic biology. Through iterative technological refinement and cross-disciplinary convergence, organoids have evolved beyond reductionist in vitro surrogates into physiologically informed and mechanism-driven platforms that advance our understanding of host-pathogen interactions while enhancing global preparedness against emerging pathogens.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注用于研究 猴痘病毒 的基于类器官的感染模型的开发和结构完善,重点是了解病毒向性、时空感染动力学和 宿主 免疫应答。核心问题是如何优化类器官平台,使其成为 猴痘病毒 研究的高保真、人类相关模型。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述系统地研究了基于类器官的感染模型的发展,重点是干细胞来源选择、细胞外基质优化和动态培养系统工程的循证策略。它评估类器官在高通量 抗病毒药物 药物筛选和临床前 疫苗 评估中的转化效用。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 类器官技术已成为病原体研究的基石平台,能够生成强大的多器官模型,用于研究病毒向性、时空感染动力学和 宿主 免疫应答。这些模型通过与共培养方法、CRISPR-Cas9 介导的遗传扰动和 3D 生物打印等先进工程策略的集成得到增强。

papers.title_zh: 用于 发病机制 研究的工程类器官平台。
papers.source_body_en: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases ranging from the 1918 H1N1 influenza pandemic to the recent SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus outbreaks continue to pose profound threats to global public health. These crises underscore the critical need for high-fidelity and human-relevant infection models. Organoid technology has emerged as a cornerstone platform for pathogen research by faithfully recapitulating the 3-dimensional architecture and physiological microenvironment of native human tissues in vitro. This review systematically examines the development and structural refinement of organoid-based infection models with an emphasis on evidence-based strategies for stem cell source selection, extracellular matrix optimization, and dynamic culture system engineering. Such advancements enable the robust generation of multi-organ models including respiratory, intestinal, and neural organoids tailored for investigating viral tropism, spatiotemporal infection kinetics, and host immune responses. Furthermore, we evaluate the translational utility of organoids in high-throughput antiviral drug screening and preclinical vaccine assessment. To further enhance physiological relevance and functional fidelity, organoid platforms are being increasingly combined with advanced engineering strategies, including coculture approaches, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated genetic perturbation, engineered microphysiological systems (such as organ-on-a-chip), and 3D bioprinting. These integrated technologies improve biomimicry while expanding experimental controllability and scalability. In addition, we critically examine the major bottlenecks limiting clinical translation and discuss emerging frontiers driven by artificial intelligence and synthetic biology. Through iterative technological refinement and cross-disciplinary convergence, organoids have evolved beyond reductionist in vitro surrogates into physiologically informed and mechanism-driven platforms that advance our understanding of host-pathogen interactions while enhancing global preparedness against emerging pathogens.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Strengthening Microbiology Research Capacity in Low-Resource African Laboratories: Opportunities, Challenges, and Governance
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming microbiological research by improving pathogen detection, accelerating genomic analysis, enhancing antimicrobial resistance surveillance, and supporting evidence-based public health decision-making. While high-income countries have integrated AI into advanced laboratory systems, many African laboratories continue to face persistent challenges, including inadequate infrastructure, shortages of highly trained personnel, fragmented data systems, unreliable electricity, and limited financial resources. Despite these constraints, several African countries have demonstrated that strategic investments in digital technologies, genomic surveillance, and international scientific collaboration can substantially strengthen microbiology research and laboratory capacity.This article examines the role of artificial intelligence in enhancing microbiology research capacity within low-resource African laboratories through a comparative analysis of empirical experiences across South Africa, Senegal, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and the Central African Republic. Rather than presenting AI as a purely technological innovation, the paper conceptualizes it as an institutional and scientific capacity-building instrument whose effectiveness depends on governance quality, human capital development, infrastructure, and collaborative research ecosystems.Drawing upon recent literature, reports from international organizations, and documented laboratory experiences, the study explores the application of AI in diagnostic microbiology, genomic surveillance, antimicrobial resistance monitoring, digital pathology, and drug discovery. Particular attention is devoted to lessons learned from responses to Ebola virus disease, COVID-19, Mpox, tuberculosis, malaria, and antimicrobial resistance. The analysis demonstrates that AI can significantly improve laboratory efficiency, diagnostic accuracy, outbreak detection, and scientific productivity when supported by appropriate institutional arrangements and sustainable investment.The article identifies persistent barriers that continue to constrain AI adoption, including digital inequality, insufficient laboratory infrastructure, limited computational resources, inadequate regulatory frameworks, data governance concerns, and shortages of multidisciplinary expertise. Building on these findings, the paper proposes an African AI Laboratory Capacity Framework comprising six mutually reinforcing dimensions: infrastructure readiness, human capital development, digital integration, data governance, collaborative research networks, and responsible AI governance.The study concludes that the future of microbiology research in Africa depends not merely on acquiring sophisticated AI technologies but on strengthening resilient scientific institutions capable of integrating technological innovation with sound governance, ethical stewardship, and long-term capacity development. By providing empirically grounded policy recommendations, this article contributes to ongoing debates on AI governance, scientific capacity building, and the modernization of laboratory systems in low-resource settings.

papers.title_zh: 人工智能增强资源匮乏的非洲实验室微生物学研究能力:机遇、挑战和治理
papers.source_body_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming microbiological research by improving pathogen detection, accelerating genomic analysis, enhancing antimicrobial resistance surveillance, and supporting evidence-based public health decision-making. While high-income countries have integrated AI into advanced laboratory systems, many African laboratories continue to face persistent challenges, including inadequate infrastructure, shortages of highly trained personnel, fragmented data systems, unreliable electricity, and limited financial resources. Despite these constraints, several African countries have demonstrated that strategic investments in digital technologies, genomic surveillance, and international scientific collaboration can substantially strengthen microbiology research and laboratory capacity.This article examines the role of artificial intelligence in enhancing microbiology research capacity within low-resource African laboratories through a comparative analysis of empirical experiences across South Africa, Senegal, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and the Central African Republic. Rather than presenting AI as a purely technological innovation, the paper conceptualizes it as an institutional and scientific capacity-building instrument whose effectiveness depends on governance quality, human capital development, infrastructure, and collaborative research ecosystems.Drawing upon recent literature, reports from international organizations, and documented laboratory experiences, the study explores the application of AI in diagnostic microbiology, genomic surveillance, antimicrobial resistance monitoring, digital pathology, and drug discovery. Particular attention is devoted to lessons learned from responses to Ebola virus disease, COVID-19, Mpox, tuberculosis, malaria, and antimicrobial resistance. The analysis demonstrates that AI can significantly improve laboratory efficiency, diagnostic accuracy, outbreak detection, and scientific productivity when supported by appropriate institutional arrangements and sustainable investment.The article identifies persistent barriers that continue to constrain AI adoption, including digital inequality, insufficient laboratory infrastructure, limited computational resources, inadequate regulatory frameworks, data governance concerns, and shortages of multidisciplinary expertise. Building on these findings, the paper proposes an African AI Laboratory Capacity Framework comprising six mutually reinforcing dimensions: infrastructure readiness, human capital development, digital integration, data governance, collaborative research networks, and responsible AI governance.The study concludes that the future of microbiology research in Africa depends not merely on acquiring sophisticated AI technologies but on strengthening resilient scientific institutions capable of integrating technological innovation with sound governance, ethical stewardship, and long-term capacity development. By providing empirically grounded policy recommendations, this article contributes to ongoing debates on AI governance, scientific capacity building, and the modernization of laboratory systems in low-resource settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 通过改进病原体检测、加速基因组分析、增强抗菌素耐药性以及支持循证公共卫生决策,正在迅速改变微生物学研究。尽管高收入国家已将人工智能融入先进的实验室系统,但许多非洲实验室仍然面临持续的挑战,包括基础设施不足、训练有素的人员短缺、数据系统分散、电力不可靠和财政资源有限。尽管存在这些限制,一些非洲国家已经证明,对数字技术、基因组监测 和国际科学合作的战略投资可以大大加强微生物学研究和实验室能力。本文通过对南非、塞内加尔、尼日利亚、肯尼亚、乌干达、刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 和中非共和国的实证经验进行比较分析,探讨了人工智能在提高资源匮乏的非洲实验室微生物学研究能力方面的作用。本文并未将人工智能视为纯粹的技术创新,而是将其概念化为一种制度和科学能力建设工具,其有效性取决于治理质量、人力资本开发、基础设施和协作研究生态系统。该研究借鉴最近的文献、国际组织的报告和记录的实验室经验,探讨了人工智能在诊断微生物学、基因组监测、抗菌药物耐药性监测、数字病理学和药物发现中的应用。特别关注从应对埃博拉病毒病、COVID-19、猴痘、结核病、疟疾和抗菌素耐药性方面吸取的经验教训。分析表明,在适当的制度安排和可持续投资的支持下,人工智能可以显着提高实验室效率、诊断准确性、暴发 检测和科学生产力。文章指出了继续限制人工智能采用的持续障碍,包括数字不平等、实验室基础设施不足、计算资源有限、监管框架不完善、数据治理问题以及多学科专业知识短缺。基于这些发现,本文提出了非洲人工智能实验室能力框架,包括六个相辅相成的维度:基础设施准备、人力资本开发、数字集成、数据治理、协作研究网络和负责任的人工智能治理。该研究得出的结论是,非洲微生物学研究的未来不仅取决于获取先进的人工智能技术,还取决于加强有弹性的科学机构,使其能够将技术创新与健全的治理、道德管理和长期能力发展相结合。通过提供基于经验的政策建议,本文有助于推动有关人工智能治理、科学能力建设和资源匮乏环境下实验室系统现代化的持续辩论。
